title: G2 Staging Evidence — Remediation Pass 3 (technical remediation/evidence review only, NOT G2 PASS)
head: g2-staging-evidence
body:
## Scope: Technical Remediation / Evidence Review ONLY

**This PR is NOT a request for G2 Full PASS, G3 authorization, or Production approval.** Per Release Owner direction, opened from g2-staging-evidence @ b3d981c to give Audit a formal space to review Remediation Pass 3 and evidence.

### What this PR contains

Remediation Pass 3 (clean branch from a0a5d11):
- scripts/g2-real-token-tests.ts — real-token test matrix (6/6 PASS)
- scripts/g2-field-contract-test.ts — field-level contract test (5/5 PASS, exact parity incl. is_fifty_baht derivation)
- scripts/g2-csv-e2e-test.ts — CSV fallback E2E (fail-closed; 2/4 PASS, 2/4 FAIL — production-code gaps documented)
- mini-services/staging-apps-script/ — Bun protocol-equivalent local test service (NOT Google Apps Script runtime)
- docs/G2-STAGING-READINESS-REPORT.md — sanitized G2 report
- docs/G2-EVIDENCE-MANIFEST.md — pointer with SHA-256 checksums
- docs/g2-evidence/06-real-token-tests.txt — redacted real-token evidence
- docs/g2-evidence/07-field-contract-test.txt — redacted field-contract evidence
- docs/g2-evidence/08-csv-e2e-evidence.txt — redacted CSV E2E evidence (fail-closed, 2/4 FAIL)

### P0 credential exposure — FIXED

Hardcoded staging DB URL removed from scripts/g2-csv-e2e-test.ts (test fails fast if env var not set). Branch history clean (no credential in any commit). Verified: git log -S companyofheroes2025 returns empty.

Outstanding (Release Owner): credential must be rotated/revoke in Supabase → Issue #15: https://github.com/nikorn2527-stack/ITAM-NextJS/issues/15

### P1 CSV test — fail-closed (honest result)

| Test | Result | Finding |
|---|---|---|
| 1a HTTP 201 | PASS | route works |
| 1b field mapping (requestId + siteCode populated) | FAIL | production-code gap, BLOCKING |
| 2 AuditLog per-record (>=1 per WorkOrder) | FAIL | production-code gap, BLOCKING |
| 3 invalid CSV rejection (400 or errorRows>0) | FAIL | production-code gap, BLOCKING |
| 4 route structure | PASS | POST + logAudit + CSV parse + jobType validation |

Honest result: 2/4 PASS, 2/4 FAIL. The 2 failures are production-code gaps (field mapping, per-record audit, validation in /api/import route) that Dev was NOT authorized to fix (Dev was scoped to test/evidence/documentation defects only). Release Owner decision needed: fix production code (separate PR) or accept as known risk.

### Outstanding blockers / dependencies (NOT closed by this PR)

1. Issue #15 (P0): Release Owner must rotate compromised credential — https://github.com/nikorn2527-stack/ITAM-NextJS/issues/15
2. Issue #14 (Path B): Audit re-review of contract-equivalent service — https://github.com/nikorn2527-stack/ITAM-NextJS/issues/14
3. Issue #13 (Path A): Ops deploy real Google Apps Script staging — https://github.com/nikorn2527-stack/ITAM-NextJS/issues/13
4. Production-code gaps (CSV field mapping + per-record audit + validation): Release Owner decision (fix or accept risk)
5. Operational dependencies (still missing): deployed TLS endpoint, access control, secret-manager binding, monitoring/rollback, risk decision

### Constraints preserved

- B4 frozen files: NOT touched (0-diff verified vs ee75164)
- SYNC_RUN: NOT added (auth-shared.ts has 0 occurrences)
- Production code: NOT changed (only test/evidence/docs)
- Secrets: NOT committed (credential removed + history cleaned + evidence redacted)

### Gate status

| Gate | Status |
|---|---|
| G2 code-only | achieved |
| G2 real-token (protocol-equivalent) | 6/6 |
| G2 field-level contract (exact parity) | 5/5 |
| G2 CSV E2E (fail-closed) | 2/4 PASS, 2/4 FAIL (production-code gaps BLOCKING) |
| G2 P0 credential | removed from code + history; pending Release Owner rotation (Issue #15) |
| G2 full PASS | pending (blockers + dependencies not closed) |
| G3 Canary | BLOCKED |
| Production | BLOCKED |

### Request

Audit may review this PR #16. Do NOT request or announce G2 PASS until the blockers (Issue #15 credential rotation) and dependencies (TLS endpoint, access control, secret-manager, monitoring/rollback, risk decision) are closed with evidence.
